messages.subject: [seewave] Plotting spektrogram in oscilogram
parts:
Dear all,
with R and SeeWave library I am plotting spectrogram in oscillogram
(see attachment Cicada.jpg).

I was using the next syntax:
spectro(a1,f=48000,ovlp=50,zp=16,collevels=seq(-40,0,0.5),colgrid="transparent",
cexaxis=1.5,cexlab=1.5,osc=T,coly0="black",widths=c(9,1),heights=c(3,2))

Is there any parameter to manipulate:
- the size of the title and numbers on upper x axis (Frequency),
- the size of the title and numbers of the Amplitude bar,
- the width and the height of the Amplitude bar ?

Thank you and best wishes, Tomi

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Plotting spektrogram in oscilogram
parts:
Dear Tomi,

There is no way to change the width and height of the dB scale except
using the layout arguments as you did. Sorry.

Changing the size of the different is not that trivial as there are
different conflicts between the functions called within the spectro()
function.
Anyway, here is a way, not very clean but it works ;-)

library(seewave)
data(tico)
par(cex.axis=1.5, cex.lab=1.5)
spectro(tico, f=22050, osc=TRUE, scalecexlab=1.5, cexlab=1.5, cexaxis=1.5)

Best

Jerome
